prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / precise-object-edit.
Create ONE high-resolution polished iPhone UI design presentation image for 多多打卡, a panda space habit app for a six-year-old. This is a narrow scoped visual revision, not a new layout.

INPUT ROLES:
Image 1 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: borrow its beautiful space-cloud overall background, sculpted colored group frames, little themed space stations on top of group headers.
Image 2 is the CURRENT IMPLEMENTED HOME PAGE and the structural/content edit target. Keep all its features, layout, panda hero, original mission illustration identities, title typography, native navigation and native tab bar, and ALWAYS TWO COLUMNS. Do not copy the horizontal short cards, full-width odd cards or invented planets from Image 1.

DELIVERABLE: a single landscape design board at highest practical resolution, ideally 3200x1760. Show FIVE equally sized believable modern iPhone screen previews side by side on a quiet neutral lavender board. Each preview is the SAME home page at a different scroll position, NOT new tabs or new pages. Each has the same original native iOS status bar, centered navigation title 多多打卡, native info button on left and parent shield on right, native iOS translucent three-tab bar at bottom with 今日打卡 selected, 打卡统计, 积分消耗. Use actual native iOS-like restrained controls, no themed navigation buttons. Small labels OUTSIDE each phone: 首页, 能量补给站, 知识探索站, 生活空间站, 勇气成长站. Screen interiors remain roomy, realistic, readable at iPhone proportions. No perspective rotation.

ONLY CHANGE THESE TWO SURFACES:
1. Overall scroll background: an atmospheric pale periwinkle/lavender sky merging into warm ivory fluffy clouds, tiny softly lit distant stars, a few translucent planets near outer margins. It is one continuous space journey scene. Keep center behind task cards calm and low contrast. No stars behind words or buttons, no busy texture. Background should enrich the current page without washing out readability.
2. Four GROUP CONTAINERS/HEADERS: adopt the style-reference's toy-like themed stations and dimensional rounded borders. Put small low-profile space buildings at top left/right corners of each group, joined by a colored smooth satin header ribbon. Decorations stay within safe content width, never overlap task titles or buttons. Keep native readable header text and compact completed-count pill. Group bases remain subtle light tinted frosted surfaces.
   - energy orange #FF8D28: a cute orange domed food/energy base with a utensil medallion at left and a tiny orange-blue rover at right. Rounded layered orange outline, warm creamy interior.
   - knowledge lavender #B0A0FF: a small blue-purple telescope and books at left, observatory dome with star window at right. Layered lavender outline, very pale lilac interior.
   - life cyan #00D2E0: small cyan living capsules with star doors, mint shrubs and clouds at the two corners. Layered cyan outline, pale aqua interior.
   - courage rose #FF375F: small rose-red dome with heart/star door at left, little flag outpost at right. Rounded rose outline, very pale pink interior.
Match the style-reference toy material and joyful game world. Make headers visually richer but compact, keeping card structure identical to current app.

INVARIANTS:
- Hero unchanged: within its rounded rectangular card the navy native title 今天也要 / 闪闪发光！ and 9月20日 · 工作日 on LEFT, panda astronaut and white/orange rocket on RIGHT, white inset native progress 0 / 13 分 and 再得13分，飞船就能出发啦！ at lower left.
- Under hero preserve native counters 0 今日自评, 0 有效打卡, 0 奖励分, 家长确认.
- Journey unchanged: 我的星际旅程; 每50分解锁星球; 本月 0 / 50; four actual solar-system preview planets 水星 金星 地球 火星 with native lock indicators. White native panel.
- Keep individual task card anatomy from Image 2: title at top left, large centered standalone clay illustration, small gold star point badge at illustration top right, one short muted time/rule line, full-width native rounded action button below. All cards equal width, always two columns. NO horizontal row cards, NO wide final odd card, NO single-column view. Odd last card stays LEFT half-width with an empty right grid cell.
- Existing image identities: sun+bed, breakfast milk+toast, lunch rice+bowl, dinner chicken+vegetables, moon+sleeping panda; headphones+books, orange pencil+notebook, books; toys basket, broom, toothbrush cup+duck, towels+soap, folded blue clothes; panda hugging pink heart, calm panda with leaves, lavender lightning, pink shield.
- All shown as initial uncompleted state, zero group counts. Do not invent scores, extra badges, levels, currency, shops, controls or content.
- Exact groups and order: energy 0 / 5 has 起床 +1, 吃早饭 +1 / 吃午饭 +1, 吃晚饭 +1 / 睡觉 +1 alone left. Knowledge 0 / 3: 认真听讲 +2, 写作业 +2 / 阅读 +2 alone left. Life 0 / 5: 收拾玩具 +1, 打扫卫生 +1 / 洗漱 +1, 干净卫生 +1 / 自己穿衣 +1 alone left. Courage 0 / 4: 乖巧听话 +2, 不发脾气 +2 / 做事不拖拉 +2, 诚实守信 +1.
- Short rule text: 起床 早上7:30前, meals 30分钟, 睡觉 晚上9:30, homework 60分钟, reading 至少15分钟, washing 晚上9:00. Untimed tasks 等你来点亮. Timed controls 开始. Single controls 打卡. Promptness gray locked 尚未解锁, 三餐、作业后解锁.
- Screen 1 shows hero and journey and beginning of energy below fold. Screens 2–5 show their respective complete groups in unchanged 2-column grid, with natural adjacent cloud background. If needed slightly reduce card illustration padding to fit 3 rows, but maintain >=44pt conceptual buttons and legible native Chinese type. Do not shrink entire app to unreadable miniatures.
- Maintain graceful safe areas, 16pt margins, consistent gaps. Decorative illustrations are only on group surroundings, never obstruct functional content. No watermarks. Premium, fun, rich yet uncluttered.
